41209.note: Trough: #10844's hand-built prototype (Patch, #10844: "41209 I like the hand built so keep it"), tapered onto the classic's sloped sides so it stays inside the classic's hull (#10846).

41214.note: Cart: #10844's TRELLIS.2 mesh (Patch, #10844 47167: "41214 trellis"), refitted by hull so it faces the classic's way (handles to -z), reduced to about 1,500 triangles as #10844 recommended, its colour baked again from the full mesh onto a fresh unwrap, and its handles, which the hull fit had split into slivers, built new as two straight poles along the classic's (#10851).

41220.note: Fountain with a spike: hand-built with the other two, as #10844 recommended "the three fountains" (Patch kept what he did not change, #10501 47170). The classic basin, wall top and water level, a plinth, corner piers and coping, and an obelisk on a stepped plinth reaching the spike's point; classic slots at the classic's texel size (#10851).

41221.note: Fountain with a stone tazza: hand-built (Patch, #10844 47167: "41221 hand built, 41214 trellis, 41239/41241 make a trellis version, 43061/43073 trellis reduced building new one where needed"). The classic pentagonal basin, wall top and water level, a plinth, corner piers and coping, a stepped base, an eight-sided shaft and a bowl whose rim is the classic's top slab with its corners cut; classic slots at the classic's texel size (#10851).

41222.note: Fountain with a cobble basin: hand-built as 41221, which #10844 recommended for both (#10851). The cobbles keep the classic's texel size, twice the wall stone's.

41239.note: Straw cart: TRELLIS.2 from #10844's 41214 redraw edited to an open box heaped with straw, so the three carts are one family; about 3,000 triangles by the seat's decision (at 1,500 the wheels tear). Only the straw, told by its baked colour, is cut from the generated mesh, so the box keeps its walls; the load is built new as a mound at the generated straw's height resting on the wall tops, with a rounded lip and a skirt over the rim (Patch saw the first version's torn rim), and the handles as two straight poles along the classic's. Colour baked from the full mesh (#10851).

41241.note: Straw cart: the same classic as 41239, plane for plane, and the same final (#10851).

43061.note: Gravestone: #10844's TRELLIS.2 mesh reduced to 349 triangles (Patch, #10844 47167: "41221 hand built, 41214 trellis, 41239/41241 make a trellis version, 43061/43073 trellis reduced building new one where needed"), worn in the classic slots at the classic's texel size, the inscribed tablet 73/2 drawn whole across the panel the classic gives it, so the granite keeps its colour and the graveyard its climate and season swaps (#10851).

43073.note: Obelisk: TRELLIS.2 from a Qwen redraw of the classic, reduced to 349 triangles and worn in the classic slots as 43061 (#10851).
